US Man Arrested for Alleged Hindu Temple Shooting Plot

A 19-year-old man was arrested in Illinois for allegedly planning a mass shooting at a Hindu temple. The weapon reportedly jammed before the attack could occur. US lawmakers and advocacy groups condemned the incident, with some warning that anti-Indian and anti-Hindu rhetoric is contributing to growing hate and violence.
